00045 NormaliserUGenInternal::NormaliserUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& level, const float duration) throw()
00046 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00047  numBuffersProcessed(0),
00048  bufferPosition(0),
00049  bufferSize((int)ugen::ceil(duration * UGen::getSampleRate())),
00050  slope(0.f),
00051  level(1.f),
00052  currentMaximum(0.f),
00053  prevMaximum(0.f),
00054  slopeFactor(1.f/ bufferSize),
00055  inputBuffer(Buffer::newClear(bufferSize, 1, true)),
00056  midBuffer(Buffer::newClear(bufferSize, 1, true)),
00057  outputBuffer(Buffer::newClear(bufferSize, 1, true))
00058 {
00059  inputs[Input] = input;
00060  inputs[Level] = level;
00061 }
00062 
00063 UGenInternal* NormaliserUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00064 {
00065  return new NormaliserUGenInternal(inputs[Input].getChannel(channel),
00066            inputs[Level].getChannel(channel),
00067            bufferSize * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate());
00068 }
00069 
00070 void NormaliserUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00071 {
00072  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00073  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00074  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00075  
00076  int bufferRemaining = bufferSize - bufferPosition;
00077  
00078  float value;
00079  float amp = *(inputs[Level].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00080  
00081  while (numSamplesToProcess > 0) 
00082  {
00083   int numSamplesThisTime = ugen::min(numSamplesToProcess, bufferRemaining);
00084   float* inputBufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData(0) + bufferPosition;
00085   float* outputBufferSamples = outputBuffer.getData(0) + bufferPosition;
00086   
00087   bufferPosition += numSamplesThisTime;
00088   numSamplesToProcess -= numSamplesThisTime;
00089   
00090   if (numBuffersProcessed >= 2) 
00091   {
00092    while(numSamplesThisTime--)
00093    {
00094     value = *inputSamples++;
00095     *inputBufferSamples++ = value;
00096     *outputSamples++ = level * *outputBufferSamples++;
00097     level += slope;
00098     value = std::abs(value);
00099     
00100     if (value > currentMaximum) 
00101      currentMaximum = value;
00102    }
00103   } 
00104   else 
00105   {
00106    while(numSamplesThisTime--)
00107    {
00108     value = *inputSamples++;
00109     *inputBufferSamples++ = value;
00110     *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
00111     level += slope;
00112     value = std::abs(value);
00113     
00114     if (value > currentMaximum) 
00115      currentMaximum = value;
00116    }
00117   }
00118   
00119   
00120   
00121   if (bufferPosition >= bufferSize) 
00122   {
00123    bufferPosition = 0;
00124    bufferRemaining = bufferSize;
00125    
00126    float nextMaximum = ugen::max(prevMaximum, currentMaximum);
00127    prevMaximum = currentMaximum;
00128    currentMaximum = 0.f;
00129    
00130    float nextLevel = nextMaximum <= 0.00001f ? 100000.f * amp : amp / nextMaximum;
00131    
00132    slope = (nextLevel - level) * slopeFactor;
00133    
00134    Buffer temp = outputBuffer;
00135    outputBuffer = midBuffer;
00136    midBuffer = inputBuffer;
00137    inputBuffer = temp;
00138    
00139    numBuffersProcessed++;
00140   }
00141  }
00142  
00143 }

00145 Normaliser::Normaliser(UGen const& input, UGen const& level, const float duration) throw()
00146 {
00147  initInternal(ugen::max(input.getNumChannels(), level.getNumChannels()));
00148  
00149  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00150  {
00151   internalUGens[i] = new NormaliserUGenInternal(input, level, duration);
00152  }
